description: This file contains utility functions for file management, including reading, writing, copying files, directory scanning, and handling version-controlled files. It appears to be a module providing file system operations for a larger Lua-based project.

methods.name: mkdir
methods.description: Creates a directory at the specified path, not compatible with Windows.

methods.name: scandir
methods.description: Lists files in a directory with specified type, using 'find' command.
